description: Open-Source Chinese Electric Power System Data is a dataset listed in Awesome Electrical Grid Mapping, a curated list of electrical grid maps, datasets and resources under the section "Asia > National-level Projects and Resources", published or maintained by github.com (publisher inferred from the link). Coverage: China (Guangxi). The list tags it as dataset. The list gives 2022 as the year of publication or last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is GPL-3.0 (as tagged in the list). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transmission and distribution network screening, hosting-capacity and grid planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-awesome-electrical-grid-mapping.
